title: 📢 NO FACE-TO-FACE CLASSES | AUGUST 18 & 19
message:
Please be informed that there will be no face-to-face classes tomorrow, August 18, 2026, due to the Orange Rainfall Warning issued by PAG-ASA. Classes will shift to asynchronous learning. Please check your respective group chats for instructions and learning materials from your teachers.

📅 August 19, 2026 - ANGONO DAY
There will also be no classes on Wednesday, August 19, in celebration of Angono Day.
